# Build & Fantomon maintenance policy

## Charming Glance season handoff

- **Before Season 2 is live on Charming Glance:** maintain both Season 1 / Tier 3 and Season 2 / Tier 4 build and Combat Fantomon recommendations.
- **Once Season 2 is live on Charming Glance:** stop ongoing Season 1 / Tier 3 build and Fantomon maintenance. Keep the existing S1/T3 builds as a legacy snapshot unless there is a site-breaking issue, but do not spend research/update effort keeping their meta current.
- After the handoff, active build maintenance is **Season 2 / Tier 4 only:** Conqueror, Guardian, Destroyer, and Dominator.

## Build format

- Organize each class around four practical presets whenever the class supports them: **Solo, Dungeon, Boss, and PvP**.
- Each preset should show the 4 Techniques and 4 Charms to equip, plus one concise offensive swap and one concise defensive swap when useful.
- Prefer exact reputable build-guide presets when they exist. When a role-specific preset must be derived from a generic build, keep the changes conservative and grounded in documented skill mechanics or repeated community testing.
- Keep recommendations limited to Techniques and Charms that actually belong in that preset; do not recommend unrelated investment pieces as though they are equipped.

## Combat Fantomon format

- Show **up to four ranked Combat Fantomon choices per Solo / Dungeon / Boss / PvP preset**.
- Mark the strongest role-appropriate consensus choice as **Main (#1)**. Choices #2-#4 are situational alternatives, not required deployed sub-slots.
- Add a short reason under each Fantomon explaining why it fits that specific preset.
- In **Season 1 / Tier 3**, evaluate Fantomons using only their currently active Assist kit. Do not give any S1 recommendation credit for Materialization/Battle skills that unlock later. Base-kit effects that already exist before Materialization remain valid.
- In **Season 2 / Tier 4**, Materialization effects may be considered once they are actually available for Charming Glance progression.

## Pandarial trigger

Pandarial releases later in Season 2. When it becomes available for Charming Glance / Global progression, re-evaluate every S2/T4 ranked Combat Fantomon list rather than assuming the pre-release rankings remain correct. Compare Pandarial against Nyxarchon, Aegiswing, Kels, Sylvaerie, Zeioletus, Mandragora, Herbote, Terragon, and any other relevant available Fantomons using current skill text and credible community testing.

Do not list Pandarial as a currently usable recommendation before it is actually available on Charming Glance. Remove future-release wording once it becomes obtainable.

## Evidence standard

Do not replace a working build from a single unsupported post. Prefer official skill text, reputable databases/guides, repeatable mechanics, or repeated community testing/consensus. Preliminary recommendations should be labeled as such instead of presented as settled meta.
